description: Netlify is a web development and cloud infrastructure platform for building, deploying, and scaling modern web applications and static sites.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth2 for user authorization apps or Personal Access Tokens (PATs) passed via Bearer token in the Authorization header.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free tier account and generate Personal Access Tokens or register OAuth applications self-serve.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering sites, deploys, functions, environment variables, forms, DNS, hooks, and agent runners.
mcp_notes: No official vendor-published MCP server found in documentation, though community or AI agent platform tools may exist.
rationale: Netlify provides a well-documented public REST API with broad capabilities and free self-serve credential generation.

evidence.note: Details OAuth2 usage and Personal Access Tokens via Bearer authorization headers.
Explains how developers generate Personal Access Tokens and register applications self-serve.
OpenAPI documentation showing comprehensive REST endpoints for sites, deploys, functions, etc.
Confirms free forever tier availability for developers.
